intent: A provider-free stacked toast system (useToasts hook + Toaster) whose cards fan out on hover, swipe away, pause while read and resolve promises in place.

layout.toaster: fixed or absolute; bottom-right/left/center from 640px; full-width bottom with 16px insets on mobile; width 360px
layout.collapsed: y = -i*14px, scale = 1 - i*0.05, origin top centre; max 3 visible; back cards take the front card's height and hide their content
layout.expanded: y = -(sum of heights in front + 10px gaps), scale 1; triggered by hover, focus-within or tap
layout.demo: 12-col grid: copy + trigger list (5 cols), editor mock-up with the toaster inside (7 cols)

motion.swipe: drag x, elastic 0.85, opacity fades to 0 at ±220px; dismiss past 90px or 600px/s with a fly-out
motion.timer: 1px line scaling X 1 -> 0 over the duration; animation-play-state paused with the JS timer
motion.iconSwap: scale 0.4 -> 1 when loading turns into success or error
motion.reducedMotion: no drag, no springs, opacity only
motion.press: buttons and links press to 0.97, full-width rows to 0.99, 150ms; one shared transition for colour and transform

responsive.mobile: stack spans the bottom with 16px insets; tap to expand, tap outside to collapse; demo stacks copy above the editor
responsive.sm: 360px stack anchored to the chosen corner

accessibility: labelled region; Alt+T focuses the newest toast
role=status (role=alert for errors) with aria-live and a full aria-label
Esc, Delete or Backspace dismisses the focused toast
close and action buttons are real buttons with visible focus rings
timers pause on hover, focus and hidden tabs
